01 / ABOUT IDENTITY

Perspective, Method & Mindset

“Breaking things to understand how they work—that’s where I thrive.”

I’m a Computer Science student focused on cybersecurity, offensive security, and generative AI. I explore how systems break, how vulnerabilities can be discovered and analyzed, and how intelligent tooling can make security research more effective.

My work spans vulnerability research, reconnaissance, attack-surface analysis, AI-powered security tooling, and full-stack development. Rather than treating security as a checklist, I view modern software through an adversarial lens: reverse engineering API endpoints to uncover unauthenticated shadow routes, analyzing LLM reasoning pipelines for prompt injection risks, and building deterministic test harnesses that verify exploit hypotheses without guessing.

Currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering at Chandigarh University, Mohali (CGPA: 8.45), I balance academic coursework with hands-on practice on TryHackMe, competitive 24-hour CTFs (such as Null Origin 2026 and H7CTF 2026), and active contributions to the university’s Cysecsphere club.
